description: This file implements the PagedAttention class, which facilitates flexible, large-batch attention mechanisms using paged memory management on top of flex_attention. It includes methods for reserving capacity, erasing batch data, assigning new key/value data, and converting logical to physical indices for attention masking.

classes.name: PagedAttention
classes.description: Supports flex attention inference with large batch sizes by splitting key/value tensors into fixed-length blocks, caching them efficiently, and enabling large batch processing while minimizing memory consumption.

methods.name: _cdiv(x: int | float | torch.Tensor, multiple: int | float | torch.Tensor)
methods.description: Performs ceiling division for integers or tensors.

methods.name: None __init__( self, n_pages: int, page_size: int, max_batch_size: int, device: str = "cuda", )
methods.description: Initializes the PagedAttention object with parameters for number of pages, page size, batch size, and device.

methods.name: None reserve(self, batch_idx: torch.Tensor, seq_len: torch.Tensor)
methods.description: Allocates pages for a specific batch based on the required sequence length.

methods.name: None erase(self, batch_idx: torch.Tensor)
methods.description: Removes a batch from the paged attention, freeing associated pages.

methods.name: None assign( self, batch_idx: torch.Tensor, input_pos: torch.Tensor, k_val: torch.Tensor, v_val: torch.Tensor, k_cache: torch.Tensor, v_cache: torch.Tensor, )
methods.description: Assigns key/value tensors to cached storage at specified batch input positions.

methods.name: BlockMask convert_logical_block_mask( self, block_mask: BlockMask, batch_idx: torch.Tensor | None = None, kv_len: torch.Tensor | None = None, )
methods.description: Converts a logical block mask into a physical block mask by mapping logical indices to physical ones.

methods.name: _mask_mod_signature get_mask_mod( self, mask_mod: _mask_mod_signature | None, kv_len: torch.Tensor | None = None, )
methods.description: Creates a mask modification function that converts logical block indices to physical indices.

methods.name: _score_mod_signature get_score_mod( self, score_mod: _score_mod_signature | None, kv_len: torch.Tensor | None = None, )
methods.description: Creates a score modification function that maps physical indices to logical indices for attention score masking.
